VBO:0201287.summary: English and Welsh Springer Spaniels are separate flushing-dog breeds. Both belong to the bird-hunting spaniel tradition; the English breed’s history includes springing game for nets, falcons and later guns.
VBO:0201287.shortDescription: English and Welsh Springers are separate spaniel breeds with a shared game-flushing tradition.
